fieldValues.statement: Meaning in the definition over meaning in the surface
fieldValues.boundary_clause: A concept the practice relies on (a status, a hold, a gate, a lane) means what its SRS definition says. Labels, board columns, brief text and code constants are surfaces: a programme binds them to the definition as its own data, and they are checked against it. Unless the surface is the only reader and nothing else acts on it; then it may stand alone until a second reader appears.
fieldValues.context: Suggested from the owner session of 2026-10-22 (clerk#121), after srs-web#595 was built three times because two components read a label differently. Extends Semantic integrity over practical expression (b3ac3391, SRS standard) to the practice; asks the SemanticOps boundary to hold the Versioning and Reference tension. Evidence: srs rulings 43249f53, 19997e24, 9ee14517 rule 4, f5b4656a; ADR-048(a); the owner's 2026-09-11 evaluation (4e83f879) that a record without an enforcement point loses to labels.
